Returns the height of an object in 2D pixel space.

Args:
    image (image): Image of the scene.
    bbox (list): A bounding box [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] containing the object.

Returns:
    int: The height of the object in pixels.

Returns the width of an object in 2D pixel space.

Args:
    image (image): Image of the scene.
    bbox (list): A bounding box [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] containing the object.

Returns:
    int: The width of the object in pixels.

Converts a pixel length to real-world meters using the depth of the object.

Args:
    image (image): Image of the scene.
    bbox (list): A bounding box [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] containing the object.
    pixel_length (int): A length in pixels to convert.

Returns:
    float: The length in meters.
